text_block_list.text:
I drop by the dance studio one morning
to find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: One, two, three!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: One... two... Yaaaawn...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Come on, Falcon.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If you really want to be the best
Umadol, you
need to work on your
dancing.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...You're the one who asked me to be
your
manager since we both have today
off.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ngh. Yeah, I know... It's just...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Waking up at five is completely
overdoing it! And
you made me run right
after!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I know it's quite strict, but based on my

calculations last night, this is the most
suitable
schedule for you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Up at 5:00 a.m. for three hours of
running
practice—endurance also plays a
critical role in
dancing, you know.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! You're so strict! Gahhh. In that
case...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I have just one request. ☆ Can we make
a promise
to take breaks and not push
ourselves too hard?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
No. You've had "just one request" ten
times today
already. Besides—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: BEEP, BEEP, BEEP, BEEP!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Time's up anyways.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, really?! Then, that means
we're done
for today!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Okay, on to our next activity. Our
afternoon
twenty-kilometer run will start
in one minute.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Say what now?! We're running again?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I watched a popular TV show to
learn some
tips. A very famous idol
talked about it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She said, and I quote, "Idols need
endurance.
They must be able to dance
through pain while
keeping a smile on
their face."
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I know you can reach such
potential!
Now then, let us be off,
Falcon!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Guh... Do you really mean that?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Then I have no choice but to do it!
Ughhh! You
really are the manager from
hell!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is completely drowned in
tasks by
her one-off manager, Eishin
Flash.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
